title: Cancellation, Refund and Transfer Figures by Rental Tier
content:
Cancellation, refund and transfer figures of Rental Property Service Contracts.

| Tier | Free-look period after the original start date | Admin fee after the free-look period | Admin fee waived on a sale cancellation | Sale cancellation window after the sale closes | Refund issued within, after a confirmed cancellation | Transfer to a purchaser allowed | Transfer fee billed to the purchaser |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance | 30 days | $50.00 | yes | 60 days | 30 days | yes | $25.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Systems | 30 days | $50.00 | yes | 60 days | 30 days | yes | $25.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | 30 days | $50.00 | yes | 60 days | 30 days | yes | $25.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | 30 days | $50.00 | yes | 60 days | 30 days | yes | $25.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | 30 days | $50.00 | yes | 60 days | 30 days | yes | $25.00 |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | 30 days | $50.00 | yes | 60 days | 30 days | yes | $25.00 |

## Column meanings

- The free-look period is the number of calendar days after the original start date within which a cancellation receives the free-look refund.
- The admin fee is the administrative fee deducted from a pro-rata refund after the free-look period.
- "Admin fee waived on a sale cancellation" states whether the admin fee is waived when the landlord cancels because the property was sold; the sale cancellation window is the number of calendar days after the property sale closes within which a sale cancellation qualifies for that waiver.
- The refund period is the number of calendar days after a confirmed cancellation within which the refund is issued.
- The transfer columns state whether the contract can be transferred to a purchaser who keeps the property as a rental, and the fee billed to the purchaser when it is.
